_comment: The kit Saad arranges. Barbell 10 kg, EZ bar 7 kg, dumbbell handles 2 kg each -- all weights INCLUDE both spinlock collars. 30 mm cast-iron plates: 20 x2, 10 x4, 5 x8, 2.5 x8, 1.25 x8, 1.0 x4, 0.5 x8. To buy on top of the existing set: 1.0 kg x4 and 0.5 kg x8 (30 mm, about EUR 30). With them every whole kilogram is loadable on the barbell, the EZ bar and the dumbbells. room.* are ceiling and floor measurements for the safety checks, not part of the load maths. Generated by tools/gen.py -- never edit by hand.

cable.note: Wall-mounted single pulley. If it is plate-loaded (a loading pin), it keeps its own small set that never leaves the cable: 5 kg x1, 2.5 kg x2, 1.25 kg x2, 0.5 kg x2 (13.5 kg in all). That is what keeps face pulls and pushdowns plate-free inside a superset. If it is a weight stack, use the stack. Progress it by reps, then load; log the setting in the set note.
